deployments_detail.use: Trayvisor (with Foodvisor): deep-learning visual recognition of meal trays at checkout that instantly identifies each dish, associates a price, generates a receipt via the TimeChef app and enables automatic nutritional analysis. Rolled out across Elior restaurants from September 2019 after Paris-region trials. [Foodvisor (Trayvisor spin-off)]

24/7 autonomous, checkout-free connected store ('24.7') at STMicroelectronics in Crolles, France: AI and computer vision (cameras/sensors) enable grab-and-go with badge payment and no checkout. Operated by Elior, built with Fujitsu, powered by Zippin. France's first 24/7 autonomous store. [Zippin (computer vision), Fujitsu (integration)]

Dynamics 365 Sales CRM with Microsoft 365 Copilot for Sales embedded in Outlook for sales operations teams (lead qualification, opportunity/contract management, email insights, automatic CRM updates) across 12 countries. [Microsoft (Dynamics 365, 365 Copilot for Sales)]
L'Atelier des Menus AI menu-planning tool plus IBM Agentic AI and Data Factory for catering operations

Agentic AI & Data Factory: a centralized platform with IBM France to build, manage and orchestrate AI agents deployed across Elior's countries and business units to autonomously process data and optimize operations, personalize services and enhance offerings. [IBM (IBM France)]

L'Atelier des Menus: in-house AI menu-planning tool trained on Elior chefs' recipes and dietitians' menu plans; generates multi-week menu proposals in minutes cross-referencing Nutri-Score/Green-Score, budget, guest preferences, seasonality and regulatory constraints. Rolling out first in the education segment. [Elior (in-house, with Group Innovation experts)]

Leanpath AI-enabled food-waste management: smart tracking devices plus AI monitor and auto-categorize food loss, identifying what is wasted and why, delivering prevention recommendations to chefs. Deployed at 14 key Elior North America sites toward 2030 goals. [Leanpath]
deployments_detail.value: targeting 50% food-waste reduction; Leanpath track record of 50%+ reductions

deployments_detail.use: Winnow Vision computer-vision food-waste tracking: camera over the waste bin recognizes discarded food items and logs weight automatically, giving chefs analytics to cut kitchen and plate waste. Pilot at Fourchette restaurant in Milan (first caterer in Italy to bring this AI into kitchens). [Winnow Solutions (Winnow Vision)]

In-house AI meal-demand forecasting tool: cross-references daily restaurant traffic, external events and weather to predict guest numbers so head chefs prepare precise quantities and avoid overproduction waste. Adopted at over 350 sites in France with progressive rollout to school cafeterias. [Elior (in-house)]
